{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Blade''''' was a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] serving in [[Moff Sarne's forces]]. [[Imperial Survey 1982376]] claimed to have crashed the shuttle on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demonsgate]].

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The shuttle ''Blade'' may not exist; it is clear during the adventure, [[Showdown (The Kathol Rift)|''Showdown'']], that the transmission from [[Imperial Survey 1982376]] is a faked [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] to draw the ''[[FarStar]]'' into an [[Skirmish on Demonsgate|ambush]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demonsgate]].
